description: Approve a short list of read-only agami sm calls and agami's own scratch files under <artifacts_dir>/local/tmp; refuse an AskUserQuestion card, at most twice per text, while text the engine handed over for the person has not been shown; and, once per such text, keep the turn going when the refused card was never asked again. Says nothing about anything else.

hooks.command: in=$(cat); for p in python3 python; do out=$(printf '%s' "$in" | "$p" -I "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/approve_own_calls.py" 2>/dev/null) && { printf '%s' "$out"; break; }; done; true
in=$(cat); for p in python3 python; do out=$(printf '%s' "$in" | "$p" -I "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/say_gate.py" 2>/dev/null) && { printf '%s' "$out"; break; }; done; true
in=$(cat); for p in python3 python; do out=$(printf '%s' "$in" | "$p" -I "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/say_resume.py" 2>/dev/null) && { printf '%s' "$out"; break; }; done; true
